impact_summary: ACCT-INT-RATE physically shares storage (REDEFINES) with ACCT-FEE-CODE. They are the same bytes under different names, so a write to one is a write to all of them - lineage below covers the whole group. Written by: ACCTMSTR:3400-SET-FEE-CODE. Read by: INTCALC:2200-APPLY-RATE-TIER. Lands in DB2 as: ACCT-FEE-CODE -> ACCOUNT_MASTER.ACCT_FEE_CODE; ACCT-INT-RATE -> ACCOUNT_MASTER.ACCT_INT_RATE.
